<thought>To identify the template that, when applied to the given molecule, reproduces the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction, I will search the template catalog using the target SMILES and the functional groups that are formed and broken in the forward reaction. The formed groups are a C=C double bond and a carboxylic ester; the broken groups are a C‑P bond, a C‑C bond, and a C‑O bond. This should return the appropriate template and its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C double bond", "carboxylic ester"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
